title: FLAT-shaded OP_QUADS color propagation regression gate (task #13)
purpose: Validates Metal renderer's CPU-side flat-quad color propagation path (task #13, mtl/vertex.c::pgraph_mtl_propagate_flat_quad_colors). 4x2 grid of 8 cells via OP_QUADS with FLAT shading. Per cell: vertices 0/1/2 (TL/TR/BR) carry BLACK distractor, vertex 3 (BL) carries the EXPECTED color (NV2A's LAST-vertex provoking rule for OP_QUADS). Without task #13's CPU propagation, every cell renders BLACK on Metal because the A-C diagonal triangulation puts vertex 0/1/2 first in Metal's [[flat]] interpolation. With task #13, vertex 3's color is replicated to vertices 0/1/2 in the streams before the draw, and the rasterizer paints each cell with its expected color. Required counter METAL_FLAT_QUAD_PROPAGATIONS >= 100 proves the propagation path engaged (>> 8 cells * ~38 fps * 6 sec = ~1824 draws expected). On real Xbox + GL renderer, the GS handles flat propagation directly so this XBE passes there too.
